name: Puketapu Pa
published: Auckland Council schedules Puketapu Pa R12_85 as a historic heritage place, recorded by the New Zealand Archaeological Association as site R12/85. The key counts the pā as one work, drawn as the scheduled extent of place; other recorded sites nearby are not in it.

sources.cite: Auckland Council, Auckland Unitary Plan Schedule 14.1 Historic Heritage, Historic Heritage Overlay Extent of Place, place 2251
New Zealand Archaeological Association site record R12/85, cited by the schedule

features.what: Pā on the ridge: ditches, terraces and storage pits
features.source: Auckland Unitary Plan, Schedule 14.1 Historic Heritage, place 2251 (Puketapu Pa R12_85); outline is the scheduled extent of place
